synopsis: The Caterpillar 777 appears as a loaded dump truck involved in a tip-head collision: a D10 dozer reversed into its wheel assembly [f3123, f11434]. Chapter 4 identifies this as an ordinary-production incident cited in WorkSafe New Zealand’s August 2017 alert [f3123]. The chapter places it alongside another documented tip-head collision in which a reversing truck clipped a dozer at night, and summarizes the New Zealand incidents as dozer-against-777 and truck-against-dozer contacts [f3357, f3557]. The glossary repeats the 777 incident, but the supplied facts provide no injury outcomes or evidence of collision-mitigation performance [f11434, f3123, f3357, f3557].

relations.note: Both describe the D10 reversing into a loaded 777’s wheel at a tip head.
Both summarize dozer-against-777 and truck-against-dozer collision examples.
Details the 777 contact and identifies the August 2017 regulatory alert.
Adds a second tip-head collision involving a reversing truck and dozer at night.
